findings.text: Provides a speculation barrier that remains empty when the processor lacks the designated fence capability and becomes a serializing fence otherwise, intended to prevent speculative execution from crossing the barrier site.

Defines ordering where the full symmetric multiprocessing barrier relies on a locked memory update to serialize, the read barrier for symmetric multiprocessing delegates to the direct memory access read barrier, and both the symmetric multiprocessing write barrier and the direct memory access barriers are compiler ordering only.

Specifies ordered accesses where the store with full barrier uses an atomic exchange, the release store validates atomic type then applies compiler ordering before a single write, and the acquire load performs a single read then validates type and applies compiler ordering before returning the observed value.
Declares barriers before and after atomic updates and after address space switching as empty operations that add no extra ordering beyond what the atomic update or switch already guarantees.

Exposes a helper that reads a sixteen bit value from low physical address 0x40E through the direct mapping and scales it by sixteen to form the extended BIOS data area base, with zero meaning no area is present.
Defines corruption detection and periodic detection startup for the BIOS area as operations without effect in this configuration, carrying no state and performing no action when called.

States that the index shift for word based bit numbering is five for thirty two bit words and six for sixty four bit words, and that the sixty four bit single bit value is one of sixty four bit type shifted by the requested index.

Requires locked bus updates for the normal set clear toggle and test with update forms to be safe across processors, while the double underscore forms use plain updates without cross processor atomicity and need external exclusion.

Describes selection by whether the bit number is known at compile time, using a byte sized locked update with mask from low three bits plus byte offset in the known case and a word sized update otherwise, together with a locked byte exclusive or that reports sign of the result and a clear with preceding compiler ordering for unlock use.

Provides test with update operations that return the previous state of the addressed bit, with locked forms for shared use and plain forms otherwise, and a lock flavor of test with set that behaves the same as the normal test with set.

Provides observation without modification through three helpers for constant index by plain load and mask, for constant acquire by ordered byte test, and for variable index by processor bit test, dispatching on constness of the index.

Provides first and last set bit queries where word helpers find lowest set and lowest clear, integer helpers return one based positions with zero when no bit is set, and the sixty four bit last set helper extends the same contract, all using compiler builtins when input is constant.

Notes that underlying bit scan operations have vendor and width dependent results for zero input, so wrappers normalize by seeding the destination or by conditional selection to ensure zero input yields a zero result.

States boot sizing where minimal kernel alignment is one shifted by a mode dependent log that equals PMD_SHIFT in one case and page shift plus thread size order in the other, with heap at 0x400000 in one mode plus 0x30000 in another plus 0x10000 in a third, stack at 0x4000 in one mode and 0x1000 in another, early page tables reserving six pages for init with warning at twenty eight pages and total at thirty two pages, and the thirty two bit trampoline spanning two pages with code at offset one page and length 0xA0.

Defines a preserve descriptor holding a byte offset from the start of boot parameters together with a byte length, plus helpers to measure a member size and to build an offset length pair from a member name.

Specifies a sanitizer that leaves input untouched when the sentinel is zero and otherwise clears scratch storage then copies only the preserve set for hdr plus screen_info plus e820_table plus e820_entries plus eddbuf plus eddbuf_entries plus edd_mbr_sig_buffer plus edd_mbr_sig_buf_entries plus efi_info plus secure_boot plus cc_blob_address plus apm_bios_info plus ist_info plus sys_desc_table plus hd0_info plus hd1_info plus tboot_addr plus olpc_ofw_header plus alt_mem_k plus scratch before replacing the whole input.

States trap encoding with single byte markers at 0xf0 for lock plus 0x0f for escape plus 0x67 for address size, with the single byte undefined variant at 0xd6 and length one, the two byte undefined at 0x0b0f and length two, plus second bytes 0x0b for undefined two and 0xb9 for undefined one.

States bug classification values near the top of sixteen bits with 0xffff for none plus 0xfff0 for lock plus 0xffd6 for debug plus 0xfffb for warning plus 0xfffc for sanitizer plus 0xfffd for undefined one plus 0xfffe for undefined two.

Describes the bug table record as position independent references to fault site and optional message plus file with line when verbose, followed by flags and padded to a uniform record size, emitted into a dedicated table section with special annotation.

Exposes fault emission that places an undefined trap at the call site while registering condition file line and flags in the bug table, marks warnings reachable, brackets with instrumentation guards, and for formatted warnings validates the format then calls the trap handler with the looked up record and arguments while preventing tail calls.

Defines variable argument storage where the system record holds two small offsets plus two pointers for overflow area and saved registers, and the architecture wrapper prefixes six saved integer registers ahead of that record.
Declares a legacy processor erratum probe that always reports absent and a platform serial fixup that performs no action.

States cache sizing where level one bytes equal one shifted by the level one shift and internode bytes equal one shifted by the internode shift, with a section marker for mostly read data and an alignment attribute combining internode alignment with page aligned data for symmetric multiprocessing.
States cache attribute flags as 0x02 for page attribute handling plus 0x01 for range register handling, each occupying a distinct low bit.

Defines integrity selection among automatic plus disabled plus kernel plus fine grained modes, with history hardening reported as zero, thunk storage as thirty two bytes, an empty call marker, a hash helper, and a seal helper for designated symbols.

States code offsets where the static offset is five in the simple case and configured padding plus five otherwise, while the runtime query yields zero by default plus sixteen for fine grained mode plus the static offset for kernel mode.
Exposes fine grained decoding that always reports failure, failure handling that always reports no trap, and arity lookup that always reports zero in this configuration.

Declares availability of architecture copy with checksum from user and checksum with copy operations, and specifies that the unchecked partial copy helper forwards directly to the generic partial copy routine.

Warns that double underscore bit updates lose cross processor safety, that area lookup returning zero must be treated as absent, that zero sentinel bypasses sanitization, and that speculation protection depends on feature patching being present.
